text:
Lena Morris: Quick sync on the RBAC + org-settings mocks I dropped. Focusing on three areas: compact roles matrix, invite drawer microcopy, and where SSO enforcement shows up. Thoughts?
Priya Shah: Thanks! Saw the mocks. Initial thought: compact matrix looks clean but loses context for which permission is 'critical'. Need affordance for seeing full perm list per role.
Tom Rivers: Agreed. Maybe a hover/expand for desktop that reveals a short list, and on mobile switch to stacked cards. Avoid horizontal scroll.
Kaito Tanaka: Accessibility flag: make sure each cell is reachable via keyboard and announces which role+perm it is. Use aria-label like "Row: Admin, Column: Manage keys, Value: allowed".
Ava (design): Copy question: invite drawer title is "Invite" vs "Invite members". We should be explicit: "Invite members to org" is clearer in admin flows. Also thinking tooltip copy: keep it under 40 chars.
Lena Morris: Good call — "Invite members to org" it is. Also want a subtle hint when SSO is on: "Org SSO: enabled" near the top, and if an invite target won't match org domains show a yellow banner.
Priya Shah: On the banner copy: prefer actionable text: "This email's domain isn't covered by your SSO. Invite will send a magic link instead." or shorter: "Non-SSO domain: invite will require email auth."
Tom Rivers: Backend note: we'll surface two flags in preview: sso_enabled (bool) and sso_domain_match (bool). Frontend logic: if sso_enabled && !sso_domain_match -> show warning banner.
Kaito Tanaka: More a11y: the SSO toggle must have role="switch" and aria-checked. If we put short hint text next to toggle, link it via aria-describedby.
Ava (design): Roles matrix affordance: add a tiny chevron to expand role details inline. On collapse show a count like "5 perms". Tooltip text for permissions should be noun-phrase: e.g., "Manage API keys" not a full sentence.
Lena Morris: Invite flow: can we validate emails as users paste a list? Inline chips with success/error states would help. Duplicate detection too.
Priya Shah: Yes, show chips. UX: invalid emails get red outline + error tooltip. Duplicates turn into single chip with "already invited" indicator.
Tom Rivers: Also consider CSV upload for >30 emails. Frontend accept .csv and parse client-side, show preview + errors.
Kaito Tanaka: Audit log nav: current mock is a long list. Add quick filters (action type, user, timeframe) and a sticky header. Keyboard scanning is important: allow focus to move to filters via Tab, then results with arrow keys.
Ava (design): Visual density: reduce vertical padding in table rows for desktop; increase touch targets on mobile. For the audit log, group-by dropdown could default to "most recent" but allow "group by user".
Lena Morris: One more microcopy: SSO enforcement tooltip. Current wording: "SSO enforced means users must sign in via SSO". Suggest: "SSO required to sign in" as the short label and full hint in tooltip.
Priya Shah: Accessibility reminder: any banner or inline message must be announced by screen readers when it appears (use aria-live).
Tom Rivers: Dev tasks: I'll add API contract: preview endpoint returns { sso_enabled: bool, domain_match: bool, duplicate_emails: [string], invalid_emails: [string] }. Frontend should not block submit if domain mismatch but should surface a clear callout.
Kaito Tanaka: For keyboard a11y on roles matrix: use role="grid" with aria-rowindex and aria-colindex. Ensure focus ring is high contrast.
Ava (design): I'll update mocks with: 1) compact matrix + inline expand, 2) invite drawer with chips + CSV CTA, 3) SSO toggles with inline hint + banner variant. Also add a11y overlay screenshot showing focus states.
Lena Morris: Great. Let's also add an experiment flag for banner severity: mild vs prominent. We'll measure invite acceptance rate + support tickets.
ui-bot: preview-build/roles-invite-updates ready at https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/roles-invite-updates (expires 48h)
Priya Shah: Small wording nit: replace "magic link" with "email link" in public-facing copy. Avoid confusing jargon.
Ava (design): Copy updated. Pushed new artboards to Figma.
Lena Morris: Thanks everyone. Action items: Ava updates assets, Tom posts API spec, Kaito compiles a11y checklist, Priya writes short copy doc. I'll reconvene after mocks are in. :white_check_mark:
